label: Onshape live document
scope: Optional external design source. The controlled fixture remains the default judge path.

documentReference.note: Server-side credentials resolve the document. These identifiers are public and safe to ship.

discovery.note: BuildReady inventories every literal length variable and infers manufacturing roles from names and feature provenance. No exact variable names are required. Ambiguous values are left unmapped.

measurementGroups.label: Inside pocket corner
measurementGroups.requiredReview: Identify the smallest concave internal corner and proposed cutter radius. A fillet may be external and is not automatically a pocket corner.

measurementGroups.label: Deep pocket
measurementGroups.requiredReview: Measure depth and minimum accessible width of the SAME pocket in the final solid; a remove-extrude depth alone is insufficient.

measurementGroups.label: Thin wall
measurementGroups.requiredReview: Measure the minimum remaining wall or rib thickness in the final solid; extrusion height is not wall thickness.

measurementGroups.label: Deep drilled hole
measurementGroups.requiredReview: Identify a drilled hole and measure its depth and diameter together; distinguish blind/through holes and counterbores.

measurementGroups.label: Mounting-hole tolerance
measurementGroups.requiredReview: Confirm the mounting-hole diameter and drawing-specified tolerance. Nominal CAD geometry does not specify a manufacturing tolerance.

writeBackPolicy.note: A write is only ever prepared after a visible human approval and is never applied to the source workspace.
